August First Fridays
events.description:
Fridays are for Fun! 

It’s time for August First Fridays!
We’ve got all sorts of fun lined up for the entire month.
From museums and restaurant deals, to shopping and kids’ activities, we’ve got something for the whole family to celebrate, all month long!
Download the event map and all the details here>>
PLUS, enter to win!*
We’re giving away an exciting prize each month.
Follow us on Facebook and Instagram to find out what the prize is and where to drop off your entry form!

First Fridays events vary. Check the schedule for details.
*Disclaimer: By entering to win, you give us permission to add your information to our system so we can notify you about upcoming events and other exciting things going on in the Aurora Downtown District. The prize will vary each month and we will announce the
prizes via our social media accounts. There will be one winner each month. One per family; no multiple submissions. We will contact the winner via email and phone. We will also notify people via social media each month of the new drop-off locations. Entrants must be 18 or older. We will draw the winner mid-month, after the first Friday.
Aurora Downtown District – where culture, creativity, and cuisine collide! From globally inspired cuisine and one-of-a-kind shops to live entertainment and inspiring public art, downtown Aurora is designed to be experienced. Just 45 minutes from Chicago, our downtown business district offers an urban vibe that’s bold, creative, and unmistakably Aurora. Welcome to Illinois’ second-largest city with a small-town feel!

events.title: The Stolp Island Block Party
events.description:
Don’t Miss Our FREE Block Party! 

🎉 Save the date, Aurora! 🎉
The Stolp Island Block Party is taking over Downtown Aurora for an evening of music, food, art, and community!
This is a FREE community event.
Come celebrate everything that makes our community special.
Whether you’re stopping by for dinner, dancing to live music, or exploring local art, there’s something for everyone!
Bring your family and friends and enjoy:

🎶 Live music
🍔 Delicious food trucks
🎨 Local artists & makers
🎈 Family-friendly activities


Details:

📅 Friday, August 7, 2026
⏰ 5:00–9:00 PM
📍 11 S. Stolp Ave, Aurora, IL
(Stolp Ave between Downer & Galena)


We can’t wait to see you there!
If you’d like to be a vendor, contact Yahayra Argueta at director@auroradowntown.org

The Stolp Island Block Party event is brought to you by Aurora Downtown District.

events.title: Kids Krew Reptile Adventure
events.description:
Come Along on the New Kids Krew Adventure! 

Calling all little adventurers – get ready for an afternoon of fun with The Kids Krew!
Join us for a FREE community event at Mundy Park, next to The Venue.
Get ready for an exciting Reptile Show, where you’ll have the chance to learn about and interact with fascinating reptiles up close.
Enjoy a wild adventure full of fun, discovery, and unforgettable animal encounters!
Registration is required – register here>>
Bring the whole family and get ready to make unforgettable memories in Downtown Aurora!

Registration is required for the Kids Krew Reptile Adventure. While supplies last.

events.title: Kids Krew Pawsome Rescue Adventure
events.description:
Come Along on the New Kids Krew Adventure! 

Calling all little adventurers – get ready for an afternoon of fun with The Kids Krew!
Join us for a FREE community event at the Regional Fire Museum in Downtown Aurora.
Enjoy a rescue-themed adventure with exciting activities for the whole family.
Create a fun craft, explore the museum, enjoy hands-on activities, and stop by for a special character meet-and-greet.
Registration is required – register here>>
We can’t wait to see you there for a day of fun, creativity, and adventure!
